name: Forearm and hand
note: Schematic right forearm, not to scale: each muscle is drawn as a belly from its origin towards its insertion, with its tendons. Positions follow standard anatomy atlases (e.g. Gray's Anatomy, 1918, public domain); shapes are simplified for teaching.

brachioradialis.name: Brachioradialis
brachioradialis.action: Elbow flexion, strongest with a neutral grip

pronator-teres.name: Pronator teres
pronator-teres.action: Turns the palm down; weak elbow flexor

fcr.name: Flexor carpi radialis
fcr.action: Wrist flexion, towards the thumb side

palmaris-longus.name: Palmaris longus
palmaris-longus.action: Wrist flexion; absent in some people

fcu.name: Flexor carpi ulnaris
fcu.action: Wrist flexion, towards the little-finger side

fds.name: Flexor digitorum superficialis
fds.action: Bends the fingers at the middle joint (PIP); also flexes the wrist

fdp.name: Flexor digitorum profundus
fdp.action: Bends the fingertips (DIP), the only muscle that does; also flexes the wrist

ecrl.name: Extensor carpi radialis longus
ecrl.action: Wrist extension, towards the thumb side

ecrb.name: Extensor carpi radialis brevis
ecrb.action: Wrist extension; the usual site of tennis elbow

edc.name: Extensor digitorum
edc.action: Straightens the fingers; also extends the wrist

ecu.name: Extensor carpi ulnaris
ecu.action: Wrist extension, towards the little-finger side

anconeus.name: Anconeus
anconeus.action: Helps the triceps extend the elbow

apl-epb.name: Abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis
apl-epb.action: Move the thumb out and back

views.title: Palm side, surface layer
views.caption: Right forearm, palm towards you: elbow at the top, thumb side on the left.

views.title: Palm side, deep layer
views.caption: Same view with the surface muscles removed: the radius (left) and ulna (right) show through.

views.title: Back of the forearm
views.caption: Right forearm from behind: elbow at the top, thumb side on the right.
